seo.titre: Become a Partner of the Route du Rhum 2026
seo.description: Associate your brand with one of the greatest sailing races in the world. Discover our partnership offers for the 2026 Route du Rhum.

sections.titre: Become a partner of the 2026 edition
Contact us to receive more information about 2026 partnership opportunities

haut.chapo: Immerse yourself in a legendary adventure and give your brand exceptional visibility by partnering with the Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe. A true emblem of French sport, this mythical event embodies values of audacity, performance, and passion that resonate with a broad, intergenerational audience.
haut.alt: The race boats lined up along the pontoon, dressed with flags, in front of the public

edition.titre: Become a partner of the 2026 edition
edition.texte: Take advantage of a powerful and renowned communication platform to boost your brand awareness, create a unique voice, and forge an authentic connection with your audiences. Grow and enhance your business by making it part of racing history.
edition.alt: A Suzuki car, official partner, in front of the ramparts of Saint-Malo

atouts.titre: Associate your image with an institution
atouts.texte: By becoming a partner of the race, you benefit from marketing rights to promote your commitment and values to the race networks and your key markets.

atouts.titre: Benefit from a powerful source of visibility
atouts.texte: With over 266 million euros in media coverage in 2022, and partnerships with the biggest French titles and media outlets, the race allows our partners to increase their exposure on a powerful and impactful platform.

atouts.titre: Enjoy an exceptional public relations programme
atouts.texte: Transcend the traditional framework of sport by offering a unique immersion into the heart of ocean adventure. More than just an event, it's an invitation to experience the emotion of the race up close with the skippers and the elements. This premium and exclusive support allows our partners to create extraordinary experiences, immerse their audience in an exceptional world, and build captivating hospitality programs to expand their business networks.
